sky cinema premiere.title: My Christmas Cowboy
sky cinema premiere.desc: Years after a college newsroom mishap sent Meg and Billy down opposite life paths, they reunite in a small Texas town to save an annual holiday event.

sky cinema premiere.title: Passenger
sky cinema premiere.desc: A few weeks into their van life adventure, a young couple witnesses an accident that leaves the driver dead. Soon, they're being pursued by a demonic stalker who's impossible to outrun and follows them wherever they go.

sky cinema premiere.title: The End of Oak Street
sky cinema premiere.desc: When a cosmic event rips Oak Street from suburbia and drops it into the unknown, the Platt family soon discover that their survival depends on sticking together in an alien landscape.

sky cinema action.title: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
sky cinema action.desc: Beginning in ancient China, the ruthless Emperor Han will stop at nothing to gain control of the region. Many years on, in the 1940s, Han's tomb is discovered, and Rick O'Connell and his wife Evelyn get drawn into a plot to resurrect the emperor and restore him to power.

sky cinema action.title: Batman & Robin
sky cinema action.desc: Batman battles super-villain Mr Freeze and seductive eco-terrorist Poison Ivy. With Freeze planning a permanent winter, faithful butler Alfred falling to a mysterious illness, and Ivy coming between the caped crusader and Robin, teaming up with Batgirl is the crime-fighting duo's only chance of saving the day.

sky cinema action.title: Justice League
sky cinema action.desc: Fuelled by his restored faith in humanity, and inspired by Superman's selfless act, Bruce Wayne enlists newfound ally Diana Prince to face an even greater threat. Together, Batman and Wonder Woman work quickly to recruit a team to stand against this newly-awakened enemy. Despite the formation of an unprecedented league of heroes in Batman, Wonder Woman, Aquaman, Cyborg and the Flash, it may be too late to save the planet from an assault of catastrophic proportions.

sky cinema action.title: The Scorpion King
sky cinema action.desc: In a time before the pyramids, an evil king threatens to take over the world, so the leaders of the remaining tribes under threat call upon a desert warrior to help them defeat the wicked one and his brutal hordes. As the warrior battles against the evil around him, he is preparing for a final showdown that will decide if it is to be his destiny to become the great Scorpion King.

sky cinema family.title: Cloudy With a Chance of Meatballs
sky cinema family.desc: Inventor Flint Lockwood dreams of discovering an idea that will change people's lives forever, and after several misguided attempts he may just have done it. Flint has invented a machine that can turn water into delicious food, and, when his first demonstration accidentally sends the machine shooting into the clouds, cheeseburgers begin raining down from the sky.

sky cinema family.title: Cloudy With a Chance of Meatballs 2
sky cinema family.desc: Discovering that his most-famous machine is now creating animal/vegetable hybrids, inventor Flint Lockwood and his friends venture forth to save the world from tacodiles, shrimpanzees and other creatures.

sky cinema comedy.title: Mamma Mia! Here We Go Again
sky cinema comedy.desc: In 1979 Donna falls in love with Sam while embarking on a series of adventures throughout Europe. In the present day, Donna's pregnant daughter reunites with her mother's old friends and boyfriends on the Greek island of Kalokairi.

sky cinema comedy.title: Bridget Jones: Mad About the Boy
sky cinema comedy.desc: After jumping back into the dating pool, single mother Bridget Jones finds herself caught between a younger man and her son's science teacher.

sky cinema comedy.title: Big Daddy
sky cinema comedy.desc: A thirtysomething slacker attempts to inject some stability into his life by adopting an impressionable five-year-old.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: The 6th Day
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: A helicopter pilot who survives a near-fatal accident, returns home to find out that has been replaced by a duplicate version of himself. In the world of the near future, cloning is rife, but the powers-that-be have jumped the gun. Once they discover that he has survived the crash, assassins are dispatched to kill him and he finds himself in the middle of a sinister conspiracy.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Five Nights at Freddy's 2
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: When Mike's 11-year-old sister sneaks out to reconnect with Freddy, Bonnie, Chica and Foxy, she sets into motion a terrifying series of events that reveal dark secrets about the true origin of Freddy's.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Star Trek Into Darkness
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: The crew of the Starship Enterprise returns home after an act of terrorism within its own organization destroys most of Starfleet. With a personal score to settle, Capt. James T. Kirk leads a mission to capture a one-man weapon of mass destruction.

sky cinema thriller.title: Mr & Mrs Smith
sky cinema thriller.desc: John and Jane Smith are a typical suburban couple first seen undergoing marriage counselling to try and get the spark back in their relationship. What neither of them knows is that the other is a highly skilled assassin until, separately, they get a call for their next job. Accidentally double-booked, they discover the truth about each other's secret existence, and are in danger not just from their bosses, but each other.

sky cinema thriller.title: Revolver
sky cinema thriller.desc: Jake Green is a hotshot gambler, long on audacity and short on common sense. Jake served seven years in jail for a crime he didn't commit after taking the rap for mean crime boss Dorothy Macha. Upon his release he takes on Macha in a private casino game, causes humiliation, and wins. While Macha puts out an order on Jake's life, Jake meets brothers Avi and Zach who protect him and plot to take Macha down.

sky cinema thriller.title: Snatch
sky cinema thriller.desc: Based on three hybridising narrative strands, three groups of villains are intent on retrieving a missing diamond. Turkish and Tommy team up with a pugilistic Irish gypsy named Mickey for the purpose of rigging unlicensed boxing matches. However, their opponent also arranges some dodgy betting with the courier of the stolen diamond, who subsequently goes missing. To complicate further, a New York gangster arrives on the scene.

sky cinema thriller.title: Hallow Road
sky cinema thriller.desc: Two parents receive a distressing late-night call from their teenage daughter, who has just accidentally hit a pedestrian. They jump in their car, racing to get there before anyone else. Disturbing revelations threaten to tear the family apart.

sky cinema greats.title: Logan's Run
sky cinema greats.desc: In 2274, computers rule a hermetically sealed city housing the survivors of a holocaust that has decimated the earth. Life is hedonistic and happy for the city's inhabitants; unfortunately they must be terminated when they reach 30. When Logan 5, a trained hunter for the system, grows intrigued by a beautiful young woman, he is forced to question the fundamental principles of his society and decides he must flee.

sky cinema greats.title: Bad Boys
sky cinema greats.desc: Two wisecracking Miami cops are forced to swap identities in order to track down $100 million of heroin stolen from the police. Their only lead is a young woman who can identify the culprits, but when they track her down, she mistakes one of the cops for his partner, forcing the pair into a bizarre and chaotic life swap.

sky cinema greats.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
sky cinema greats.desc: Epic tale in which an intrepid archaeologist tries to beat a band of Nazis to a unique religious relic which is central to their plans for world domination. Battling against a snake phobia and a vengeful ex-girlfriend, Indiana Jones is in constant peril, making hair's-breadth escapes at every turn in this celebration of the innocent adventure movies of an earlier era.

sky cinema drama.title: Molly's Game
sky cinema drama.desc: Molly Bloom runs the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested by the FBI. Her only ally is defence lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learns that there is much more to Molly than the tabloids lead people to believe.

sky cinema drama.title: Bohemian Rhapsody
sky cinema drama.desc: Singer Freddie Mercury defies stereotypes and convention to become one of history's most beloved entertainers. After leaving Queen to pursue a solo career, Mercury reunites with the band for one of the greatest performances in rock 'n' roll history.

sky cinema drama.title: Downton Abbey: The Grand Finale
sky cinema drama.desc: In the summer of 1930, the Crawleys grapple with the threat of social disgrace when Mary finds herself at the centre of a public scandal and the family face financial trouble.
